title: Separation of Concerns (SoC)
points: Split a system into parts, each handling a distinct concern: presentation, business logic, data access.
Changes in one concern don't ripple into others.
trade: SoC works at many levels (layers, modules, classes, methods). SRP is the class-level version of it.
test: Name the three concerns in a typical Spring Boot endpoint and where each lives.
answer: HTTP handling in the controller, business rules in the service, persistence in the repository.

questions.question: In a Spring Boot app, a controller runs SQL and calculates tax. Which principle does this violate?
questions.explanation: HTTP handling, business rules and persistence are separate concerns. Put them in the controller, service and repository.
